title: Open Calls Interview
eyebrow: GUI.Forms · rich text, controls and theme language · 2026-10-26
lede: Fifteen open calls from three tracks: SwiftEdit's rich text library plan (PR #344), the W controls, and the T3 theme language worker's confirmations. Each has a recommendation. Your answers are kept in this browser; save them to a file or copy the record back to the coordinating session.
context_html:
Where things stand

Everyone has resumed after the reboot. T3 has built P1 to P5 and is in P6 materials; W has the file, folder and colour dialogs, ThreadExceptionDialog and tab images; SwiftEdit's stx_rtf plan is PR #344. The T3 choices in section C are already built as recommended; they change only if you reverse them.
footer_html: They become owner decisions in each track's README, and the workers build on them.
